paper.title: The Enhanced Hydrogen Storage Capacity of Carbon Fibers: The Effect of Hollow Porous Structure and Surface Modification

defaults.verified_by: Agent B (sonnet, independent re-extraction of Tables 1-3): ~142 cells, 0 numeric disputes (Pd 0.5 Vp: Table value 1.43 used over the body-text 1.42, resolved to the table). material_class/synthesis_method/surface_area_method/metal_element and uptake_type=unspecified confirmed; 12 'This work' samples captured once each; the 5 literature rows and 2 calculated values (4.78/0.67 wt%) correctly excluded. Agent C adjudication: pore_diameter_method HK->other on the five Waverage rows (the Table 2 footnote attributes Waverage to the Saito-Foley method, distinct from the Horvath-Kawazoe used for the micropore volume; Saito-Foley is not a schema literal).

notes.type: uptake_type=unspecified (exact-word rule): the paper labels these 'hydrogen storage capacity'/'H2 uptake'/'hydrogen capacity'; neither 'excess' nor 'total' is used for any value
notes.cond: all H2 values are at 77 K and 10 MPa (=100 bar) (Table 2/Table 3 headers, abstract); isotherm saturates by ~2 MPa (section 3.2) but the reported capacity is the 100-bar value
notes.method: H2 by the gravimetric method at 77 K (ISOSORP-HyGrA, Waters); N2 sorption at 77 K (ASAP 2020) for texture; the paper states no H2 purity, no sample mass and describes no buoyancy/void-volume correction, so no calibration point
notes.sa: surface_area_method=BET; SBET from Table 1/2/3; total pore volume Vp is a single-point value at P/P0~0.99 (Table footnotes), so pore_volume_method is set to HK (the method stated for the micropore volume Vmicro) with the total noted as single-point; micropore volume Vmicro by Horvath-Kawazoe (HK)
notes.wavg: average_pore_diameter is Waverage, the average micropore width determined by the Saito-Foley method (Table 2 footnote); Saito-Foley is not a schema literal and is distinct from the Horvath-Kawazoe method used for the micropore VOLUME, so pore_diameter_method=other (Agent B HYC-0044 adjudication); reported only for the five Table-2 samples
notes.cf: CF is a non-porous (SBET 11) carbon fibre from carbonization of mono-component PAN; non-activated carbon fibre -> class 'other' (HYC-0024-S1 precedent); synthesis_method=carbonization
notes.pcf: PCF is a porous carbon fibre made by carbonization of the PVA-removed PAN fibre (no activation agent; porosity from sacrificial PVA removal), so it is a non-activated carbon fibre -> class 'other' (HYC-0024-S1 precedent), synthesis_method=carbonization
notes.acf: ACF/APCF are KOH-chemically-activated carbon fibres -> class 'activated_carbon' (HYC-0024-S2/S3 precedent), synthesis_method=chemical_activation
notes.pd: Pd-decorated APCF_H 0.3 is metal-bearing -> class 'composite' with metal_element=Pd (HYC-0027/29/39/40 convention); synthesis_method=chemical_activation (the carbon component's route); Pd electrodeposited from 0.1/0.5/1 mM PdCl2; the loading is given only as a supplementary atomic-% (Table S1, unavailable), so metal_loading is empty
notes.charonly: characterization-only row (Table 1 texture; this process-optimisation sample was not taken to H2 testing and any H2 is only in the unavailable supplementary Fig S1), so measurement_method=not_applicable and uptake is empty (HYC-0007/0033 precedent)
notes.chahine: Chahine note: 77 K, 100 bar; scored by the rubric against the BET bound

S1.label: CF
S1.material_description: carbon fibre from carbonization (1200 C, N2) of mono-component PAN wet-spun fibre; non-porous reference

S2.label: ACF
S2.material_description: activated carbon fibre from KOH activation of carbonized mono-component PAN fibre
S2.activation_method: KOH chemical activation: PCF immersed in 8 M KOH 60 C 4 h, dried, calcined 900 C 1 h under N2, HCl wash to remove residual K

S3.label: PCF_H 0.3
S3.material_description: porous carbon fibre (PAN/PVA_H 7:3): PVA_H selectively removed from the wet-spun PAN/PVA bi-component fibre, then carbonized at 1200 C; not activated

S4.label: APCF_H 0.3
S4.material_description: activated porous carbon fibre: PCF_H 0.3 after KOH chemical activation
S4.activation_method: KOH chemical activation: PCF immersed in 8 M KOH 60 C 4 h, dried, calcined 900 C 1 h under N2, HCl wash to remove residual K

S5.label: Pd 0.1/APCF_H 0.3
S5.material_description: Pd-electrodeposited (0.1 mM PdCl2) activated porous carbon fibre APCF_H 0.3
S5.activation_method: KOH chemical activation: PCF immersed in 8 M KOH 60 C 4 h, dried, calcined 900 C 1 h under N2, HCl wash to remove residual K; then Pd electrodeposited from 0.1 mM PdCl2

S6.label: Pd 0.5/APCF_H 0.3
S6.material_description: Pd-electrodeposited (0.5 mM PdCl2) activated porous carbon fibre APCF_H 0.3 (Pd NP ~41.7 nm)
S6.activation_method: KOH chemical activation: PCF immersed in 8 M KOH 60 C 4 h, dried, calcined 900 C 1 h under N2, HCl wash to remove residual K; then Pd electrodeposited from 0.5 mM PdCl2

S7.label: Pd 1/APCF_H 0.3
S7.material_description: Pd-electrodeposited (1 mM PdCl2) activated porous carbon fibre APCF_H 0.3
S7.activation_method: KOH chemical activation: PCF immersed in 8 M KOH 60 C 4 h, dried, calcined 900 C 1 h under N2, HCl wash to remove residual K; then Pd electrodeposited from 1 mM PdCl2

S8.label: PCF_L 0.5
S8.material_description: porous carbon fibre (PAN/PVA_L 5:5), low-MW PVA removed then carbonized; characterization-only

S9.label: PCF_L 0.3
S9.material_description: porous carbon fibre (PAN/PVA_L 7:3), low-MW PVA removed then carbonized; characterization-only

S10.label: PCF_L 0.1
S10.material_description: porous carbon fibre (PAN/PVA_L 9:1), low-MW PVA removed then carbonized; characterization-only

S11.label: PCF_H 0.5
S11.material_description: porous carbon fibre (PAN/PVA_H 5:5), high-MW PVA removed then carbonized; characterization-only

S12.label: PCF_H 0.1
S12.material_description: porous carbon fibre (PAN/PVA_H 9:1), high-MW PVA removed then carbonized; characterization-only
